phi-scan: synthetic

This fixture is CDC schedule-page text saved by a browser. The `8/12/26, 10:25 AM`
lines are the capture stamps `classify` keys on to call a document a web-capture,
so the fixture is worthless without a date in that shape. They are print
timestamps from a public CDC page and carry nothing about any patient.

Everything above the first page marker is preamble and is not read as a page. The
marker cannot be written out here, because a fixture that names its own delimiter
splits on the mention and grows a page nobody wrote.

%%PAGE%%
An official website of the United States government
Recommended Vaccinations for Adults
Vaccines by Age
VaxView Vaccination Coverage
8/12/26, 10:25 AM
Recommended Vaccinations for Adults | Vaccines & Immunizations | CDC
https://www.cdc.gov/vaccines/imz-schedules/adult-easyread.html
